verdict.rationale: The evidence only supports a USB-A Solo 2 with a reversible plug, plus a vendor line that it fits 'any USB port'. Nothing shows a USB-C model, a keychain form factor or a nano form factor, so the lineup breadth in the story is mostly unproven. missing for 10: documented USB-C model, keychain form factor, low-profile nano form factor, first-party lineup/spec documentation of port and form-factor variants.

support.subject: As a power user, the lineup covers my ports and carry style — USB-C and USB-A models, keychain and low-profile nano form factors

citations.quote: "Reversible USB-A" now there's a feature I wish we'd see more often!
Solo v2 is much more robust, water resistant, has stronger NFC & reversible usb plug.
Insert your Solo 2 into any USB port.
